title: Dedicated, considered legal representation
description:
Advocate Dr. Vishnu Sharma is a Delhi-based legal practitioner with more than fifteen years of legal practice experience. His professional work encompasses civil disputes, criminal proceedings, matrimonial and family matters, property concerns, and related legal questions. The practice is built around a straightforward belief: legal decisions should be based on facts, relevant documents and a realistic understanding of procedure.

Clients approach a lawyer at very different moments. Some have received a court notice and need to understand the next step. Others want to resolve a family dispute, clarify ownership of a property, recover a contractual payment, or discuss a criminal matter. People living outside India may need assistance understanding a case or document affecting property or family members here. Each situation requires its own evaluation rather than a generic answer.

The website has been created as an information and enquiry resource. It explains the types of matters on which a consultation may be requested, what documents are commonly relevant, and how a legal review generally begins. An enquiry does not, on its own, create an advocate–client relationship; the scope of any engagement must be confirmed separately.

title: A considered approach to each legal matter
description: A document-focused consultation process, adapted to individual requirements.
bullets:
Listen & understand|Start with the person's objectives, the full chronology, pending proceedings and the facts that are in dispute. Identify what is urgent and what information is still missing.
Examine & assess|Review the documents, applicable law, jurisdiction, limitation and available remedies. Explain important uncertainties instead of suggesting that every case has the same answer.
Plan the next step|Consider whether the matter calls for communication, negotiation, mediation, drafting, an application or litigation. Set out the documents and procedural work involved.
Represent & communicate|Where an engagement is accepted, carry out the agreed legal steps and discuss significant developments. Procedural timelines and outcomes remain subject to the relevant forum.

title: The principles behind our work
description: Clear communication, thoughtful legal planning, and careful evaluation.
bullets:
Clarity before action|Explain the legal question in accessible language, distinguish established facts from assumptions, and outline feasible avenues.
Document-led assessment|Use orders, correspondence, contracts, records and dates to understand the strength and limits of each position.
Respect for confidentiality|Sensitive family, commercial and criminal matters should be discussed through appropriate channels, not exposed in public enquiries.
No promises of outcomes|A responsible legal assessment acknowledges the court's role, evidentiary issues, opposing positions and uncertainties.

title: Assistance with India-related concerns
description: For a person living abroad, distance creates practical challenges: arranging documents, understanding Indian legal notices, reviewing powers of attorney, and coordinating communication across time zones. The practice provides a channel to enquire about such India-related matters without suggesting that it has offices or legal licensing in every other country.\n\nWhere questions involve foreign immigration law, cross-border recognition of orders or other foreign-jurisdiction issues, advice from appropriately qualified counsel in that jurisdiction may also be necessary.
